Hi team,

I need to get urgent approvals for a critical stay package for Samir Patel (platform IC on Search). He just received an external offer and our retention window is narrow — recruiting asks for a counter asap. I ran a preliminary comp model and attached the manager case + calc. High level request:

- Merit increase: 15% base increase (market make-up)
- One-time cash: $30,000 spot bonus (paid in next payroll)
- Equity: 0.40% refresh (RSU equivalent, accelerated 2-year vest schedule if approved)

Rationale: Samir is the primary contributor for the Search relevance rewrite; losing him will create >3 month delivery slip and risk several customer rollouts. He was out-sourced to a recruiter last week (offer details attached). This sits outside standard comp bands and exceeds Marissa's 30k cash threshold for manager-level approvals, so I'm routing to rewards/finance.

Ask: please confirm whether we can approve as-is or propose trade-offs (reduce cash / increase equity). If approved, we need: payroll instruction, equity request in Carta, and DocuSign for the amended offer. I'm aiming to communicate to Samir by EOD Monday (2/16).

Attachments: comp_calc_samir_2026.xlsx; manager_case_samir.pdf

Thanks —
Grace
